page.title: CodeUp
profile.display.name: Display name
profile.display.name.help: Your ad name will be displayed on your profile and is publicly visible.
profile.links.help: Add links to your social profiles so that others can get to know you better. Please make sure to enter each link in a new line.
profile.readme.help: Write a brief description about you so that others can get to know you better. You can use Markdown to format your text.
repos.create.name: Name
repos.create.name.helper: Give your project a clear name.
repos.create.public.helper: Do you want your repository to be publicly visible?
repos.create.deploy.type.helper: Select the release type for your repository. STATIC means that your repository is published as a static website. DYNAMIC means that your repository is published as a dynamic website.
repos.create.deploy.name: Publication URL
repos.create.deploy.name.helper: Enter a unique name for publishing your project. This name is used in the URL.
repos.delete.confirm: Do you really want to delete the repository? This action cannot be undone.
repos.clone.one: There are several ways to edit the repository:
repos.clone.local: You can clone and edit the repository locally on your computer (PC/Mac). You must already have Git and a code editor installed.
repos.clone.cloud: Alternatively, you can use your CodeUp Cloud PC and the integrated desktop app to edit and publish your project later.
